title: The Heavy Wool Pocket
description: A split second of pure panic transforms into sudden relief when keys turn up in an unexpected winter coat pocket.
engagement_comment: Sometimes the things we lose were just waiting safely in yesterday's pockets.
factory_topic: relief: Finding the misplaced car keys inside the pocket of your winter coat that has been hanging in the back of the hallway closet since last spring, right when you are running late and panicked.
